Players Committee card image of [[Maul]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Never deploys to a battleground. Opponent may not cancel your destiny draws. Once per turn, may add 1 to a just drawn battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may subtract 1 from a just drawn battle or weapon destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Maul.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Maul.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
